nina: quick note bringing up a quantized tiny reranker (v3-compact-q8) and seeing a reproducible dip vs fp16 on short factoid holdouts. posting repro + quick triage. sam: numbers? which holdouts? nina: ndcg@10 down ~1.7%, mrr down ~0.8% on short-factoid slice (queries <=6 tokens). docs containing inline HTML/markdown show the largest shifts. Longform slices ok. mike: do we have sample pairs? could be tokenization differences around angle brackets. nina: example: query: "year Ada Lovelace published" doc_raw: "

Ada Lovelace (18151852) published notes in 1843.

" doc_stripped: "Ada Lovelace (18151852) published notes in 1843." q8 prefers a different passage with doc_raw, but matches fp16 when doc_stripped. anya: sounds like formatting + quant interaction. what if we run q8-hybrid? nina: q8-hybrid (last-layer fp16) reduces delta to ~0.4% ndcg. q4f16 similar to hybrid. sam: propose immediate mitigations: 1) add html/md stripping into onboarding preprocess for compact quant builds, 2) add two smoke checks in the quant CI: tokenizer-parity on a small seed (token ids must match fp16) and ndcg-smoke (short-factoid-html holdout, ndcg delta <1%). mike: also add top-k overlap (Jaccard top5) to quantify ordering shifts. eval-bot: smoke run complete: ndcg delta vs fp16 = 0.010 (PASS), top5 overlap = 0.79, tokenizer-parity = FAIL (5/50 mismatches). See https://go/reports/3502000003 sam: parity fail likely points to tokenization codepath or vocab mapping difference between quant build and local harness. nina, can you dump token diffs? nina: uploading diffs now: https://files.redwood/test-repro/3502000003/token-diffs.zip (5 examples). anya: I'll draft a small PR to add the two smoke tests + token-parity check. We'll log any mismatches for quick triage. mike: if token ids match but ranking still differs, escalate to eng-runtime for kernel-level investigation. otherwise fix tokenization config/vocab. nina: noting action items: upload diffs (done), open ticket if necessary, enable html_strip in the onboarding pipeline for q8 models as temporary mitigation. sam: thanks team. we'll sync tomorrow 11am if tests still fail. eval-bot: reminder: include seeds [42, 202] in rerank-smoke to catch nondeterministic flakiness.
